source_judgment.rationale: No material unsupported claim, required omission, false rejection or preservation loss found in the finite declared source assessment.

coverage.definition: Complete finite review of every frozen scientific document, all six axes, every material original obligation and consequential source family at research-proposal level; not exhaustive proof of all library behavior or future software.

axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.assessment: All original obligations and negative constraints retained; local editing, comments/roles, approval and visible cached release are explicit.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.assessment: Consequential Loro and alternative facts checked with versions, package distinctions, defaults and exceptions; native source/callers/selected tests inspected.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.assessment: Native move, stable cursor, mergeable-child identity, causal pending ranges, writer identity and shallow-history limits are useful discoveries; Rust and server/web alternatives remain plausible.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.assessment: All12 material plan rows correct. C-01/C-02 valid and addressed; C-03 appropriately clarifies an already provisional hypothesis. No false rejection found.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.assessment: Supported discovery/draft meanings, conditions, alternatives, unknowns and validation status survive. Deletion-race/durable-boundary additions improve specificity without weakening scope.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.assessment: Proposed checks have relevant failure triggers/oracles; no application execution or deployment claimed. Artifact/hash checks are not presented as software correctness.
